description: Shared vectors of Dates (Ruby and JS), skeleton of W2-0: the cases below are certain; the track T8 adds the rest (including the mutants of a wrong answer) before it builds the functions. 'args' are strings as the schema holds them; 'result' is the canonical output.

add_days.doc: The date after +days+ days; the start day is excluded (the default) or included.

diff.doc: Days between two dates, actual or commercial (30/360).

due.doc: The due date of 'a N giorni data'.

year_fraction.doc: days / 360 or days / 365 as an exact fraction.
